entries.alt: Jesus speaks with seated listeners while an older man holds a bound set of metal plates.
entries.caption: Jesus gives the listeners His attention as He explains the scriptures. His teaching opens their understanding and prepares words of hope for generations still to come.
entries.findings: Actual canonical Christ reference compared: recognizable face, curly dark hair and beard, gentle engaged expression; His eyes meet the woman nearest Him, whose gaze returns to Him. Hands and clothing coherent. Raised hand viewed chiefly from back/edge; healed wrist mark visible, palm surface naturally turned away. Lower hand palm turned inward/down and wrist partly under sleeve, no forced display. No fresh blood. Record prop closed and unlettered; not an authenticated artifact.
conditions: Treat plates, exact setting, seating and unnamed listeners as artistic interpretation; do not assert this man is Nephi or a named record keeper.
Retain Malachi/3Nephi26 explanatory context, distinct from initial appearance and from Emmaus.
Technical pass is not owner aesthetic approval or browser verification.
